worksheet: CLAIM / FORECAST: state the conclusion precisely.
EVIDENCE: cite at least three observations, calculations, map features or model results.
PHYSICAL REASONING: connect evidence to governing atmospheric processes.
UNCERTAINTY: identify plausible alternatives, confidence and forecast bust modes.
Complete the daily exit check, then the 10-question weekly mastery quiz. Both require 80%.
